item.title: Implementing FIDO2 / YubiKey in Microsoft Entra ID Without Mobile Authenticator and handling Self-Service-Password-Reset (SSPR)
item.description:
Overview #

FIDO2 security keys offer a secure and convenient passwordless authentication method. For organizations where employees either lack company-issued phones or prefer not to use personal devices for authentication, this hardware token becomes a viable alternative. Here’s how to implement FIDO2/YubiKey as the sole authentication method in Microsoft Entra ID.

item.title: Remove User Photos in Microsoft Entra ID in Bulk with Microsoft Graph
item.description: This blog post will guide you through a PowerShell script that uses the Microsoft Graph PowerShell module to remove user photos in bulk.
